FAQ

What is the MOQ for roll stock?
The MOQ is typically calculated by the minimum weight or meters required for a production run, usually around 500 equivalent pouches or a minimum of 200kg.

How do I ensure it fits my packing machine?
We need your machine's specification: roll width, maximum roll diameter, core size (usually 3" or 6"), and winding direction.

Do you offer cold-seal film?
Yes. We provide cold-seal adhesive coating for heat-sensitive products like chocolate bars and protein bars.

Technical Specification

Custom Roll Stock Film Technical Specification

The table below is written for industrial RFQ comparison. Final production specification is confirmed by machine compatibility testing.

Recommended material structureBOPP 20µm / VMPET 12µm / PE 30-50µm; PET 12µm / AL 7µm / PE 50µm; BOPP/CPP for economy
Coefficient of Friction (COF)0.20 – 0.35 (Kinetic) for high-speed automatic packing machines (VFFS/HFFS)
Barrier targetOTR ≤ 1.5 cc/m²·day; WVTR ≤ 1.5 g/m²·day for snack shelf life
Roll Width / RepeatWidth 50mm - 1000mm; Repeat confirmed by eye-mark position
Seal strength≥ 20 N / 15 mm at machine-specific temperature settings
Winding DirectionPosition 1-4 (as per machine spec); Core size 76mm (3") or 152mm (6")
Surface finishMatte, Glossy, Soft-touch, Cold-seal optional
Printing registration tolerance±0.3 mm for eye-mark tracking
Recommended testCoefficient of Friction test + Heat seal curve test + Machine run test
MOQRun-specific (equivalent to 500+ standard units)
Artwork fileAI / PDF / PSD accepted; vector logo required; 3 mm bleed
Color toleranceΔE ≤ 3.0 against approved digital proof
Dimension tolerance±1 mm on slitting width; ±0.5 mm on repeat length
Quality inspectionAQL 2.5 for major defects; 100% video inspection for print defects
RFQ data requiredRoll width, repeat, material, winding direction, artwork, quantity, destination

RFQ Checklist for Factory Quotation

  1. Confirm roll width, core size and winding direction for your machine.
  2. Send AI/PDF artwork with 3 mm bleed and eye-mark position.
  3. Choose material structure (Foil vs Metallized vs Clear) and COF requirement.
  4. Tell us destination country, quantity (kg/meters) and delivery method.
